ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِه ذِي الْمَقَامَاتِ الْجَلِيْلَةِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Dhi ‘l-maqāmāti ‘l-jalīlah.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, possessor of momentous processions!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِه وَخَلِّقْنَا بِأَخْلَاقِهِ الْجَمِيْلَةِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa khalliqnā bi akhlāqihi ‘l-jamīlah.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and imbue us with his beautiful character!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِه وَهَبْ لَنَا قَلْبًا شَكُوْرًا .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa hab lanā qalban shakūrā.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and bestow upon us grateful hearts!!
